name: Tomasa Tassara — birth about 1864, Buenos Aires, Argentina
researcher_question: When and where was Tomasa Tassara born, the wife of Juan Rossello and mother of Juan Felipe Marcelo (christened 15 August 1885), Angela (born 31 July 1889) and Maria (christened 25 February 1899) Rossello at Mercedes, Buenos Aires, Argentina?
notes: Record-hint fixture (filtered-list-samples-3.csv row 33, hint-samples.csv row 13, flag adds_birth, confidence 3). Resolved OUTCOME 1 (true match). The hint (ark:/61903/1:1:MW49-LBB, Argentina censo nacional 1895) is Tomasa Tassara, married, Birth 1864 Buenos Aires, Cuartel 01 (Poblacion rural) Mercedes -- the wife of tree person GW82-2VP. Identity rests on the INDEX, which is sufficient: the 1895 census independently indexes, each as its own record in that same cuartel, husband Juan Rossello (ark:/61903/1:1:MW49-LBT, b.1858 Italy) and children Juan (MW49-LB5, 1886), Catalina (MW49-LBY, 1888), Angela (MW49-LB1, 1890) and Bartolome (MW49-LBR, 1892), each child's year within one of the tree's, with Maria (tree b.1898) correctly absent. The register image (ark:/61903/3:1:S3HY-674Q-DT3) was examined and shows Tomasa among a Rossello household, but a Step 1a two-entry check surfaced a discrepancy: Pedro Ratti the father (ark:/61903/1:1:MW49-L1W) read age 40 by OCR against an indexed 60 -- a mismatch on the age column. Under the Step 1a rule (either entry differs -> discard the transcription), the reading is NOT relied upon, so image_basis is omitted (Ballestrero MW49-L19 and Ratti the son MW49-L1Q did match, but one same-page mismatch withholds the licence). Birth kept at 'about 1864' (age-derived, and indexed) and birthplace at 'Buenos Aires, Argentina' (census column F reads 'Bs Aires' -- province or city); not sharpened to the city or an exact year.
